Rainey Street & Riverfront.name: Rainey Street & Riverfront
Rainey Street & Riverfront.description: Bungalow-to-tower conversion district on Lady Bird Lake's north shore, where hotel and residential towers dominate the permit pipeline.

Warehouse District.name: Warehouse District
Warehouse District.description: Historic supply-warehouse blocks west of Congress now carrying office-to-residential conversions and ground-floor hospitality.

Congress Ave & Capitol Complex.name: Congress Ave & Capitol Complex
Congress Ave & Capitol Complex.description: Capitol-view office spine with the Texas Capitol complex and state-tenant demand anchoring the state government economy.

East Cesar Chavez & Holly.name: East Cesar Chavez & Holly
East Cesar Chavez & Holly.description: Former industrial riverfront edge east of I-35 with townhome infill, music-venue adaptive reuse, and sustained small-lot development.

East 6th Street Corridor.name: East 6th Street Corridor
East 6th Street Corridor.description: Bar-and-venue strip turned mixed-use corridor with mid-rise multifamily replacing single-story commercial east of the highway.

Mueller & Cherrywood.name: Mueller & Cherrywood
Mueller & Cherrywood.description: Master-planned airport redevelopment with continued buildout phases adjacent to Cherrywood and Windsor Park bungalow stock.

South Congress (SoCo).name: South Congress (SoCo)
South Congress (SoCo).description: Hotel-and-retail flagship corridor with boutique lodging conversions and skyline-view multifamily on its side streets.

Travis Heights.name: Travis Heights
Travis Heights.description: Historic district of craftsman and mid-century stock south of Lake Shore Drive, with renovation-heavy permitting and strict tree ordinances.

Bouldin Creek.name: Bouldin Creek
Bouldin Creek.description: Cottage-grid neighbourhood between S 1st and Lamar with teardown/rebuild pressure and independent retail spines.

The Domain & North Burnet.name: The Domain & North Burnet
The Domain & North Burnet.description: Apple-, Amazon- and Meta-anchored secondary downtown under the Burnet/Braker overlay, with the metro's densest office pipeline outside the core.

Hyde Park & North Loop.name: Hyde Park & North Loop
Hyde Park & North Loop.description: Streetcar-era bungalow historic district meeting the North Loop indie-retail strip, with renovation-led permits and neighborhood-conservation overlays.

Westlake Hills Edge.name: Westlake Hills Edge
Westlake Hills Edge.description: Hill-country estate stock at the Westlake village boundary with teardown-rebuild mansions dominating a low-volume, high-value permit mix.

Barton Hills & Zilker.name: Barton Hills & Zilker
Barton Hills & Zilker.description: Park-adjacent post-war residential hills beside Zilker Park, drawing renovation capital from greenbelt access.

South Lamar Corridor.name: South Lamar Corridor
South Lamar Corridor.description: Strip-retail arterial undergoing station-area densification with multifamily replacements of aging retail and motel stock.

Tech Ridge & Pflugerville South.name: Tech Ridge & Pflugerville South
Tech Ridge & Pflugerville South.description: Transit-oriented park-and-ride node shading into Pflugerville's southern subdivisions along the I-35 growth spine.

Round Rock Edge & La Frontera.name: Round Rock Edge & La Frontera
Round Rock Edge & La Frontera.description: Williamson County commercial edge at the metro's northern boundary, permitted through Round Rock rather than the City of Austin.
